records.name: Chia Seeds
records.description: Small seeds rich in fibre and plant omega-3 fats.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

cautions: Increase gradually and drink enough fluids.
Whole seeds should be consumed with adequate liquid.
records.servingSuggestions: Add to curd, oats, smoothies or soaked puddings.
records.selectionTips: Choose dry seeds without moisture or rancid smell.
records.storageTips: Store airtight in a cool, dry place; refrigeration can extend freshness.

records.name: Flax Seeds
records.description: Seeds rich in fibre and alpha-linolenic acid.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides fibre and plant omega-3 ALA.
Ground flax can be incorporated into many foods.
cautions: Large amounts may cause digestive discomfort.
records.servingSuggestions: Use ground in oats, curd, chutney or batter.
records.selectionTips: Choose clean, dry seeds with fresh aroma.
records.storageTips: Store airtight; ground flax is best refrigerated.

records.name: Sesame Seeds
records.description: Oil-rich seeds used in Indian cooking and sweets.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

cautions: Sesame is a major food allergen.
Portions matter because seeds are energy-dense.
records.servingSuggestions: Use in chutney, podi, breads and vegetable dishes.
records.selectionTips: Choose clean seeds without rancid odor.
records.storageTips: Store airtight away from heat; refrigerate for longer storage.

records.name: Sunflower Seeds
records.description: Edible sunflower kernels used as a snack and ingredient.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides protein, fibre and vitamin E.
cautions: Salted versions can be high in sodium.
records.servingSuggestions: Add unsalted kernels to salads, oats or snacks.
records.selectionTips: Choose fresh kernels without rancid smell.
records.storageTips: Store airtight; refrigerate for longer storage.
